judge_methodology_notes: Methodology v2 (post-2026-05-10 correction): the judge scores the generated SOAP against the TRANSCRIPT as source of truth. The reference clinician note is auxiliary signal only (it is itself imperfect). A fact is a hallucination IF AND ONLY IF the transcript does not support it. See docs/eval-runs/primock57-20260510T222316Z.md for the v1→v2 methodology delta.
judge_parse_failure_notes: Sonnet 4.6 occasionally emits chain-of-thought prose before the JSON object, defeating strict JSON.parse. The follow-up script change (extractFirstJsonObject helper) salvages these going forward; 3/57 cases on this baseline are excluded from the score aggregate. See the primock57-run.ts diff in PR #200.

subscores_mean.subscore_methodology: Means computed across the 54 valid cases. Individual per-case subscores are in the report.

hallucination_categories_observed: anatomy substitutions (eyebrow vs elbow — likely ASR-side, not L4)
dosing-ambiguity resolution (resolving to one interpretation without flagging)

alert_thresholds.watch: cases_with_hallucinations_above 60 percent for two consecutive runs
